33b342bf02a71e79a230.headline: Aeon ta kara kudin bincike zuwa dala miliyan 2
33b342bf02a71e79a230.dek: Kamfanin tsaron yanar gizo na Najeriya ya samu hannun jari daga Launch Africa Ventures da Octerra Capital bayan ya tara dala miliyan 1 a watan Satumba.
33b342bf02a71e79a230.why: Kararin kudin da Aeon ta samu na gina kayayyakin tsaron yanar gizo ne a fadin Afirka da kuma Kudancin Duniya.
paragraphs: Aeon, wani kamfanin tsaron yanar gizo na Najeriya, ya kara wa'adin neman kudadensa na farko zuwa dala miliyan 2 yayin da yake gina kayayyakin tsaron yanar gizo don Afirka da kuma Kudancin Duniya.
Kararin kudin ya zo ne tare da sabbin jarin da aka zuba daga Launch Africa Ventures da Octerra Capital.

Wannan karin kudin ya biyo bayan zagayen neman kudi na dala miliyan 1 da Aeon ta yi a watan Satumba na 2026, wanda kamfanin Terra Industries ya jagoranta. Kamfanin na cigaba da gina abin da ya bayyana a matsayin ababen more rayuwa na tsaron yanar gizo ga yankin da kuma Kudancin Duniya.

7813ddc653688276978c.headline: Obi ya yi makokin Pete Edochie, dan shekara 79
7813ddc653688276978c.dek: Tsohon gwamnan jihar Anambra ya yabi tsohon dan wasan kwaikwayon saboda nuna rayuwar Okonkwo a fim din Things Fall Apart na Chinua Achebe.
7813ddc653688276978c.why: Masu kallo da cibiyoyin al'adu na Najeriya sun rasa dan wasan da rawar da ya taka ta sanya al'adun gida ga masu kallo a fadin duniya.
paragraphs: Peter Obi, dan takarar shugaban kasa na jam'iyyar Nigeria Democratic Congress kuma tsohon gwamnan jihar Anambra, ya yi makokin tsohon dan wasan Nollywood Pete Edochie bayan iyalan sun sanar da rasuwarsa a ranar Laraba. Edochie yana da shekaru 79 a duniya.

A sakon ta'aziyya da ya fitar a shafin X, Obi ya ce Edochie ya taimaka wajen sanya al'adun Najeriya da na Afirka ga masu kallo a fadin duniya, musamman ta hanyar fitowa a matsayin Okonkwo a cikin shirin talabijin na littafin Chinua Achebe mai suna Things Fall Apart. Obi ya kuma yabi kwarewar dan wasan a harshen Turanci da Inyamuranci da kuma gogewarsa a fannin watsa labarai.

Shugaba Bola Tinubu shi ma ya yi makokin rasuwar Edochie, inda ya kira shi a matsayin majagaba a Nollywood wanda ayyukansa suka tallata al'adun Najeriya a duniya, kamar yadda jaridar The Punch ta ruwaito. Gwamnan jihar Enugu Peter Mbah ya bayyana rasuwar a matsayin babban rashi ga jihar, kamar yadda jaridar Premium Times ta rawaito.

3f9a0e2f82f20d825bdb.headline: Yankin Yogo a Nijar ya kwashe fiye da shekaru 125
3f9a0e2f82f20d825bdb.dek: Al'ummar Nijar dake kusa da iyakar Chadi ta samu shugabanni biyar tun bayan kafa ta a hukumance a shekarar 1900, inda aka zabi sabon shugaba a 2025.
3f9a0e2f82f20d825bdb.why: Iyalan Yiriya Kedelaya da ‘yan kasuwa a bangarorin biyu na iyaka na ci gaba da kasancewa a hade ta hanyar kasuwancin ketare da alaka ta dangi.
paragraphs: Yogo, wani yanki na Toubou a yankin N’Gourti na kasar Nijar, ya samu shugabanni biyar jeri tun bayan kafa shi a hukumance a shekarar 1900, kamar yadda hukumar labarai ta Agence Nigerienne de Presse ta ruwaito. Yankin yana da tazarar kilomita hudu daga iyakar kasar Chadi kuma shi ne gidan al'ummar Yiriya Kedelaya.

An zabi shugaba na yanzu, Kedella Hamet Kedella Botrane, a ranar 5 ga Maris 2025 domin gaje babban yayansa. Shugabannin masarautar sun hada da Kedella Kalli Okimi, wanda ya rike mukamin daga 1914 zuwa 1968, da Kedella Ali Kedella Botrane, wanda ya shugabanci daga 2002 har zuwa rasuwarsa a 2024.

Tarihin al'ummar ya koma kan wata babban masarautar da aka kafa kusan a shekarar 1800, kamar yadda kabilun da shugaban na yanzu ya bayyana suka nuna. Mazauna yankin sun dade suna kiwon rakuma da tumaki da kuma yin kasuwanci tsakanin iyakoki, yayin da suke kiyaye dangantaka ta dangi da ta tattalin arziki a bangarorin biyu.

9674cd6a6de3caa15341.headline: Nijar ta bayar da rahoton mutuwar mutane 81 a ambaliya
9674cd6a6de3caa15341.dek: Ambaliyar ta shafi mutane 97,334 tare da lalata gidaje 12,985, inji wakilin ma'aikatar yawan jama'a.
9674cd6a6de3caa15341.why: Gidaje 13,976 da abin ya shafa na fuskantar lalacewar gidaje da dabbobi, yayin da jami'ai za su ba da shawarwarin matakan rigakafi na 2027.
paragraphs: Nijar ta rubuta mutuwar mutane 81 tare da jikkata wasu 131 sakamakon ambaliyar ruwa zuwa ranar 31 ga Oktoba 2026, a cewar Sani Douda, wakilin ministan Yawan Jama'a, Ayyukan Jama'a da Hadin Kan Kasa, a ranar 24 ga Nuwamba a Maradi. Ambaliyar ta shafi mutane 97,334 a fadin gidaje 13,976.

Douda ya ce adadin ya kuma hada da rugujewar gidaje 12,985 da mutuwar dabbobi 1,366. Jami'ai da abokan hulda sun hadu a Maradi domin duba yadda aka mayar da martani a 2026, gano nakasu tare da ba da shawarwarin yadda za a inganta rigakafi da sarrafa ambaliyar ruwa a 2027.

Douda ya ce ayyukan bana sun hada da karfafa tsarin gargadi na farko, shirye-shiryen aiki da kuma tattara al'umma. Gaspard Cirhalwirwa, mataimakin shugaban ofishin hukumar abinci ta duniya (WFP) a Maradi, ya ce hukumar za ta ci gaba da goyon bayan kokarin Nijar na riga-kafi da kuma sarrafa bala'i.

f183339c26eb29906121.headline: Kungiyar Gwamnonin Najeriya ta janye daga rikicin Paris Club
f183339c26eb29906121.dek: Rikicin ya ta ne a kan dala miliyan 100, kodayake rahoton da ake da shi bai nuna abin da adadin ya kunsa ba.
f183339c26eb29906121.why: Dole ne Kungiyar Gwamnonin Najeriya ta fayyace matsayinta kan rikicin kudaden da aka bayyana a matsayin dala miliyan 100.
paragraphs: Kungiyar Gwamnonin Najeriya ta nuna cewa ba ta da alaka da wani rikici kan kudaden Paris Club, kamar yadda wani labari da jaridar The Punch ta wallafa a ranar Laraba ya nuna. Labarin ya bayyana cewa rikicin ya shafi dala miliyan 100 ne.

Rubutun da ke cikin rahoton bai bayar da wani bayani kan abin da kungiyar ta ce ba, ko wanene ke neman kudaden, ko kuma gwamnatocin da abin ya shafa. Haka kuma bai bayyana abin da adadin dala miliyan 100 din ya kunsa ba.
Jaridar The Punch ta wallafa labarin ne a ranar 25/11/2026 da karfe 07:03:16. Rahoton nata bai bayar da kararin bayani kan rikicin ko kuma wani mataki na gaba ba.

b0f3d39386c854243b81.headline: Obaigbena ya musanta samun gayyatar ‘yan sanda a kan First Bank
b0f3d39386c854243b81.dek: Shugaban THISDAY da ARISE ya ce tattaunawar sasanci da First Bank da GHL na cigaba bayan hukuncin Kotun Koli.
b0f3d39386c854243b81.why: First Bank da GHL na cigaba da tattaunawar sasanci bayan hukuncin da Kotun Koli ta yanke a ranar 3 ga Yuli saboda GHL, yayin da ake ci gaba da tattaunawa kan basussukan da ake zargin ana bin kamfanonin yada labaran.
paragraphs: Nduka Obaigbena, shugaban kamfanonin yada labarai na Najeriya wato THISDAY, da kuma gidan talabijin na ARISE, ya ce bai samu wata gayyata ta 'yan sanda ko wata sanarwa daga hukumomin tsaro ba game da rikicin da ya shafi First Bank da kamfanoninsa na yada labarai. A cikin wata sanarwa da the ofishinsa ya fitar a Ikoyi, Legas, ya musanta rahotannin da ke cewa 'yan sanda sun bayyana shi a matsayin wanda ake nema ruwa a jallo kuma ya musanta barazana ga babban jami'in First Bank Olusegun Alebiosu.

Ofishin Obaigbena ya ce ya binciki duka adireshinsa kuma bai ga wata gayyata da ta shafi bincike ba. Ya danganta rahotannin da wani rikici na kudi da ya shafi First Bank, GHL, THISDAY Newspapers da ARISE Television, kuma ya ce ana tattaunawa domin shawo kan matsalolin da suka rage. Sanarwar ta ce Kotun Koli ta yanke hukunci baki daya, 5-0, domin goyon bayan GHL a shari'arta da First Bank a ranar 3 ga Yuli, 2026.

Sanarwar ta ce First Bank da GHL sun binciko yiwuwar sasanci a wajen kotu tun bayan hukuncin, yayin da kokarin magance basussukan da ake zargin ana bin kamfanonin yada labarai ke ci gaba. Obaigbena ya ce ya yi magana da manyan jami'an ‘yan sanda a ranar 19 ga Nuwamba game da shirin kafa tsaron ‘yan sandan jihohi.

6aff435695f0adbb5a42.headline: Tiani ya kira majalisar tuntuba ta Nijar domin duba dokoki biyu
6aff435695f0adbb5a42.dek: Majalisar za ta kuma saurari bayanan gwamnati kan korar Mohamids da kuma shugabancin gwamnati.
6aff435695f0adbb5a42.why: Mambobin majalisar za su yi nazarin daftarin dokokin zanga-zanga da tarurruka, da dokar tsaron zamantakewa, da kuma sakonnin gwamnati lokacin da zaman zai fara a 1 ga Disamba.
paragraphs: Shugaban Nijar Abdourahamane Tiani ya sanya hannu kan wani doka a ranar 24 ga Nuwamba wacce ke kiran zama na biyu na yau da kullum na Majalisar Tuntuba domin Sake Ginawa a shekarar 2026. An tsara buɗe zaman ne a ranar 1 ga Disamba a Yamai.

Ajandar majalisar ta ƙunshi daftarin dokoki game da ƙa'idojin zanga-zanga da tarurruka a Nijar da kuma kan dokar tsaron zamantakewa, a cewar dokar. Haka kuma mambobin za su duba bayanan gwamnati, ciki har da tattaunawa kan korar Mohamids daga ƙasar da kuma harkokin shugabancin gwamnati.
Dokar ta bai wa majalisar waɗannan batutuwa domin ta yi la'akari da su a zamanta na ƙarshe na yau da kullum a wannan shekara.

9f8712d5e12d82ffdfa7.headline: Katsina ta dakatar da Sarkin Daura daga ayyukan hukuma da tafiye-tafiye
9f8712d5e12d82ffdfa7.dek: Gwamnatin jihar ta dauki mataki ne bayan wata 'yar yawon bude ido dan kasar Poland ta zargi Umar Farouk Umar da taba mata kirji.
9f8712d5e12d82ffdfa7.why: Dole ne sarkin ya dakatar da harkokin hukuma da tafiye-tafiye yayin da gwamnatin jihar Katsina ke martani ga zargin.
paragraphs: Gwamnatin jihar Katsina ta dakatar da Umar Farouk Umar, Sarkin Daura, daga harkokin hukuma da tafiye-tafiye bayan wata 'yar yawon buɗe ido ƴar ƙasar Poland ta zarge shi da aikata laifin lalata. Baƙuwar ta ce basaraken mai shekaru 92 a duniya ya riƙe mata kirji a yayin wani haɗuwa ta yawon buɗe ido.

Umar bai ce komai ba game da zargin ko dakatarwarsa. Gwamnatin ta dauki matakin ne biyo bayan kiran da aka yi a kafafen sada zumunta na zamani na a dakatar da sarkin tare da bincikarsa, a cewar gidan rediyon BBC Africa.

Umar ya riƙe sarautar tun a shekarar 2007, lokacin da ya gaje ɗan uwansa, wanda ya yi mulki na tsawon shekaru 41. Sarakuna na riƙe da tasiri na al'adu da na addini a arewacin Najeriya, kodayake sun rasa ikon siyasa.

f34674a389a08e81bab4.headline: Nijar ta buɗe taron masu zuba jari da shawarwarin ayyuka 30
f34674a389a08e81bab4.dek: Firayim Minista Ali Mahamane Lamine Zeine ya ce ayyukan sun shafi noma, ma'adinai, makamashi, kayayyakin aiki da sauran sassa.
f34674a389a08e81bab4.why: Masu zuba jari da ke la'akari da shawarwari 30 suna samun daidaiton kulawa, da kariya ga dukiya da kuma sauyin kuɗi a ƙarƙashin dokar da aka sake dubawa, a cewar Zeine.
paragraphs: Nijar ta buɗe taron ta na farko na Ƙasa da Ƙasa domin Zuba Jari a Nijar a Yamai a ranar Talata, 24 ga Nuwamba 2026, inda Firayim Minista Ali Mahamane Lamine Zeine ya gabatar da fayilolin zuba jari kusan 30 ga masu zuba jari na cikin gida da na ƙasashen waje. Shawarwarin sun ƙunshi noma da masana'antar noma, ma'adinai, mai da gas, makamashi, ababen more rayuwa na sufuri da sadarwa, da kuma ruwan ƙasa.

Zeine ya ce ƙasar ta sake dubawa da dokarta ta zuba jari a watan Fabrairu na 2025. Ya ce tana ba da daidaiton kulawa ba tare da la'akari da ɗan ƙasar da mai zuba jarin yake ba, tana kare dukiyar sirri kuma tana ba da damar sauya kuɗin shiga, riba da kudaden da aka samu daga sayarwa. Dokar ta kuma ce dokoki na gaba ba za su iya rage fa'idodin da aka ba wa amincewar zuba jari ba.

Zeine ya bayyana rashin tsaro a matsayin babban cikas ga zuba jari kuma ya ce an kafa wani rundunar ƙasa musamman domin kare babban zuba jari da hanyoyin samar da kayayyaki. Ya ce rundunar tana ba da tsare-tsaren tsaro na musamman ga masu zuba jari.

826bdd8ba0c776b3600c.headline: Gwamnan Agadez ya godewa malaman addini bisa addu'oin zaman lafiya a Nijar
826bdd8ba0c776b3600c.dek: Gwamna Ibra Boulama Issa ya halarci karatun Alkur'ani da addu'o'i a Masallacin Amiskini, inda ya isar da godiya daga Shugaba Abdourahamane Tiani.
826bdd8ba0c776b3600c.why: An nemi malaman addini a Agadez da su ci gaba da yin addu'o'i, tare da gwamnan ya isar da godiyar hukumomin gwamnatin ƙasa.
paragraphs: Gwamnan Agadez Ibra Boulama Issa ya halarci karatun Alkur'ani wanda ya biyo bayan addu'o'in zaman lafiya da wadata a Masallacin Amiskini a ranar Talata, 24 ga Nuwamba. Sakataren Gwamnati na yankin Agadez, da baturen gudanarwa na yankin birnin Agadez, da Sarkin Aïr, da shugabannin addini, da jami'an tsaro, da wakilan ƙungiyoyin farar hula suma sun halarci taron.

Boulama ya ce addu'o'in sun roƙi Allah ya albarkaci Nijar, al'ummarta da shugabanninta, da kuma cigaba da sanya ƙasar a matsayin ƙasar zaman lafiya, natsuwa da wadata. Ya kuma nemi a albarkaci da goyon bayan jami'an tsaron ƙasar, waɗanda ya ce suna yaƙi kullum domin kare yankinta, da kuma tabbatar da cewa Ƙawancen Kasashen Sahel (AES) ta kasance yankin zaman lafiya da ci gaba.

Boulama ya godewa kuma ya taya malaman addini murna a madadin Shugaba Abdourahamane Tiani, tare da isar da godiya daga firayim minista da daukacin gwamnati. Ya buƙaci su ci gaba da ninkaya da ir waɗannan addu'o'i domin Nijar.
